gloss: wasted effort; futile labor; vain attempt

definitions.gloss: wasted effort; futile labor; fruitless work
definitions.explanation: Effort that produces no result; work done in vain. Emphasizes the pointlessness of the endeavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説得|せっとく}→説得：14219_settoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{徒労|とろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The attempt to persuade ended in vain.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ{以上|いじょう}→これ以上：25431_koreijou⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{徒労|とろう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think searching any further would be a waste of effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、すべて⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{徒労|とろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I spent hours preparing, but the event was canceled and it was all for nothing.

notes:
USAGE:
{徒労|とろう} is a somewhat formal word used to describe effort that yielded no results. The most common pattern is {徒労|とろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in futility).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徒労|とろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in vain)
- {徒労|とろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|き}す (to come to nothing — literary)
- {徒労|とろう}{感|かん} (a sense of wasted effort)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧: waste (more casual, broader usage)
- ⟦{骨折|ほねお}り{損|ぞん}→骨折り損：08029_honeorizon⟧: wasted effort (colloquial expression)
